text: Above: here is a new addition to my touring inventory just received from Amazon ... made in Japan, very good quality, somewhat heavy, but I think it's worth the carry.
annual chart of percentage change of day length, various latitudes

The two graphs above are important for those who are on the road and living outdoors throughout the year.

The length of days changes at varying rates depending on latitude, and one must always be conscious of how far north or south you want to go, and when to turn around as seasons change.
Looking down unto my handlebars, I've mounted a simple but very nice compass. Also notice the hand sanitizer readily available.
